title: Primogems Source
description: A single source of primogems in a given version

name.description: Display name, e.g. "魔神任务第五章第三幕"

category.description: one-time = permanent content; recurring = resets per cycle; limited-time = version event only

value.description: Primogems amount. Use 0 for sources that grant other currency (fates, wishes).

unit.description: Reward unit type. mixed = primogems plus other rewards.

note.description: Optional note on amount, e.g. "per phase clear"

rewards.description: Rewards split by currency. Do not convert fates into primogems in stored data.

other.description: Non-wish rewards. Keep their text here instead of inventing a primogem equivalent.

verification.description: Editorial verification state for the reward amount and availability.

isOneTime.description: true if this source can only be claimed once per account

estimatedMinutes.description: Estimated time to complete in minutes. 0 for passive sources (e.g. maintenance compensation).

difficulty.description: easy = no combat/story; medium = some combat or puzzle; hard = high investment or skill needed; passive = no player action

description.description: Brief description of what the player needs to do

prerequisite.description: Optional prerequisite, e.g. "需要完成魔神任务第五章第二幕"

guideLinks.description: Links to guide videos or articles

creator.description: UP creator name, e.g. "你的影月月"

bvid.description: Bilibili BV ID if platform is bilibili

timestamp.description: Time stamp in the video, e.g. "12:30"
